sloka: उपस्थितं तु तं दृष्ट्वा पुष्पकं पुष्पभूषितम् ।अविदूरस्थितो रामं प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ।। ६.१२५.१ ।।
transliteration: upasthitaṁ tu taṁ dṛṣṭvā puṣpakaṁ puṣpabhūṣitam ।avidūrasthito rāmaṁ pratyuvāca vibhīṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.125.1 ।।

translations.english: Offering to Sri Rama the Pushpak decorated with flowers to sit, Vibheeshana stood at a distance and spoke.
